report.explanation: Fixture suggestion for the stale draft.

steps.text: reviewing a draft that the site will edit mid-review

args.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { if (document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-skills-armed')) { return resolve((() => { const t = document.querySelector('textarea'); t.value = 'Draft one'; t.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true })); return { value: t.value }; })()); } if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ armTimeout: true }); setTimeout(tick, 100); }; tick(); })

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { if (s && s.state === 'suggestion') return resolve({ state: s.state, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: s && s.state }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }).catch(() => { if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: 'error' }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }); }; tick(); })

(() => { const b = document.querySelector("button[data-skill-fixture='tamper']"); b.click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ value: document.querySelector('textarea').value, types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 100)); })()

(() => { document.querySelector("button[data-skill-fixture='submit']").click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), held: window.__fixture.log.filter((e) => e.type === 'gate-hold').length }), 100)); })()

new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), value: document.querySelector('textarea').value, types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 5000))
